title: Title 15 - BUILDINGS AND CONSTRUCTION
full_text:
Section D101.2 is added to read as follows: 
D101.2—Definition—Fire Apparatus Access Road. A road that provides fire apparatus access from a fire station to a facility, building or portion thereof. This is a general term inclusive of all other terms such as fire lane, public street, private street, parking lot lane, access road way and drive way.

(Ord. No. 1484, § 2(Exh. L), 11-24-2025)
